reports.title: Population estimates
reports.description: Population estimates. Population is approximately 26–27 million inside the country; large-scale displacement (internal and external) remains a defining demographic feature.
reports._notes: Core demographic node. Population ~26–27 million; displacement is structural.
reports._url_evidence: UNFPA World Population Dashboard page for Syria; page shows 'Total Population (2025): 25,600,000' plus age-structure and demographic indicators.
reports._cadence_evidence: UNFPA World Population Dashboard country page; its technical notes state the indicators 'are updated annually', drawing on the UN Population Division's World Population Prospects (2024 revision). Current figure shown is 25.6m for 2025.

reports.title: National Accounts of Syria (GDP)
reports.description: National accounts and GDP estimates. The economy contracted catastrophically during the conflict; recovery remains partial and data quality is limited. External estimates are widely used for surveillance.
reports._notes: Primary macroeconomic output node under severe data constraints.
reports._url_evidence: UNSD (UN Statistics Division) country profile for the Syrian Arab Republic showing GDP in million current US$ (2015/2020/2025), GDP growth rate and GDP per capita, plus sectoral gross value added.
reports._cadence_evidence: data.un.org country profile is the UNdata application - '50+ statistical indicators for 229 countries/territories' - rendered as a live indicator table (values for 2015, 2020, 2025 with 2023/2024 estimates). No editions, no issue dates and no stated release cycle.
reports.cadence_note: Continuously updated database/portal with no discrete editions. The number is the renderer convention decided 2026-08-18 (HANDOFF section 7) and applied 2026-08-19: a nominal releases_per_year so that absence keeps meaning 'one-off instrument' only - 250 encodes business-day updating (the live corpus's daily-FX convention), 365 genuinely all-days monitoring. It is a statement of continuous flow for the pulse/beam system, not a claim of counted editions - the observed reality is in _cadence_evidence.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.description: CPI and inflation rates. Inflation has been extremely elevated and volatile under currency collapse, supply disruption and monetary financing pressures.
reports._notes: Core high-frequency price node under extreme inflation conditions.
reports._url_evidence: Central Bank of Syria 'تقارير التضخم الشهرية' (Monthly Inflation Reports) list, with columns for M-o-M, Y-o-Y and CPI values; the series runs 2018 to August 2020 and has not been updated since.
reports._cadence_evidence: Central Bank of Syria page is headed 'تقارير التضخم الشهرية' (Monthly Inflation Reports) and tabulates one report per month with M-o-M, Y-o-Y and CPI: 12 editions in 2018, 12 in 2019 and 8 in 2020. Series is dormant - the last edition is August 2020.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Syria / external estimates
reports.description: BOP and external-sector statistics where available. Formal trade and capital flows are limited; remittances, humanitarian inflows and informal channels dominate the external position.
reports._notes: External-accounts node under constrained formal data and large informal/humanitarian flows.
_referenced_by: Central Bank monetary and external analysis
reports._url_evidence: Central Bank of Syria 'إحصاءات ميزان المدفوعات' (Balance of Payments Statistics) category page, linking to current-account-balance and international-investment-position indicator series in million US$.
reports._cadence_evidence: CBS balance-of-payments landing page only offers four unlinked table headings (BOP indicators, international investment position, relative change in key BOP indicators, BOP indicators as % of GDP). No dates, no editions and no periodicity stated.

reports.title: Exchange-rate and Syrian pound statistics
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Syria / market monitoring
reports.description: Official and parallel-market exchange rates for the Syrian pound. The pound has depreciated massively from pre-war levels (tens of thousands per USD in recent parallel readings); the gap between official and market rates and extreme inflation are structural features.
reports._url_evidence: Central Bank of Syria 'النشرة الرسمية' (Official Exchange Rate Bulletin) archive, with dated bulletins running through 6 August 2026 and mid-rate values listed per publication date.
reports._cadence_evidence: CBS 'النشرة الرسمية' (Official Bulletin) of exchange rates: one downloadable bulletin per date, entries running continuously from 8 July 2026 to 18 August 2026 with gaps only on weekends, across a 125-page archive. Business-daily publication; this is the one CBS series still current.
